- ⛔ No workflow, no gate script, no objectui file, no changeset text.
- ⛔ No release act.
Container & model: `S (two registry entries, proved on the PR's own path-filtered Spec Shape Gate run)`, `mode:subagent`, `model: TIER_DEFAULT`
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `the hourly Spec Shape Gate on main has failed since fbb42d900 on five unregistered diagnostics from PRs #24970 and #24778, and the release gate reads that run (#25055)` | `none: the gate's attribution table reads only the newest 40 pulls of a 51-commit range, so neither producing PR appears in it` | `the next release's publish lane (scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs --release-gate) and every lane whose hourly run the red masks`
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared: no open PR in objectstack touches `scripts/ci/spec-shape-retirements.json` or the gate, and no open PR in objectui touches the three named test files. No live `Claim:` on a `pm:dispatched` card names the registry (read at 2026-10-21T08:41Z). No dev of this session is in flight: #25054's PR has landed.
